title: 마지막 직선
suno_analysis_sp: K-Hip Hop track featuring a male rapper. The arrangement centers on a distorted, fuzzy electric guitar riff playing a syncopated four-bar loop. A trap-influenced drum kit features a punchy kick drum, crisp snare on the backbeat, and rapid-fire 32nd-note hi-hat rolls. A deep 808 sub-bass follows the kick pattern. The tempo is 150 BPM in the key of G minor. The vocal delivery is rhythmic and aggressive with rapid-fire Korean and English phrasing. Occasional record scratches and vocal chops are used as transitions.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, record scratch]
[808 bass and trap drums enter]

[Verse 1]
[aggressive male rap vocals]
뱌라머는 건 다 사믈 머ᄆ겨 갸성기 터비면 생가건 꺼겨
Let me talk 까지는 게 개하대로 다려
Spike가 패글 재 소리가 나가로아 파를 펼쳐
바라믈 가라지 여ᄑ lane 발소리가 저ᄆ저ᄆ 가까오지
이 1m 터 꼬너 언시ᄆ려게 모미 기우러 시ᄆ장기 갈비벼를 두드려
마지마ᄀ 지ᄀ서니갸 다리갸 버텨
